repo.name: Ruycast
repo.product_surface: Native macOS launcher, Settings, CLI and readable configuration

vision.one_line: A fast native Mac launcher that people and their AI tools can customize.
vision.north_star: Daily keyboard actions stay predictable, private and easy to automate.
vision.promise: A fresh build works with a neutral profile; management is available through validated local interfaces.

principles.rule: Every management action should have a safe CLI or file interface.
good: CLI JSON status and guarded config changes
principles.title: Agent First

principles.rule: Keep configuration, command definitions and measurement outputs structured.
good: Validated JSON profiles and machine-readable results
bad: Scraping human prose to run an action
principles.title: Json First

principles.rule: Keep everyday input responsive and show one launcher panel.
principles.title: Native And Responsive

principles.rule: Store history and analytics locally with explicit privacy boundaries.
principles.title: Local First

principles.rule: Distinguish fixtures from desktop behavior and source previews from signed releases.
bad: Declaring leak freedom from a short test
principles.title: Honest Evidence

non_goals: Full compatibility with every Raycast extension
Bundling personal vault or customer integrations

required_boundaries: Explicit unmeasured performance and distribution gaps

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the app work without private infrastructure?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Neutral configuration and isolated host/native checks pass.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can an agent manage configuration safely?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: CLI JSON and compare-and-swap configuration checks pass.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can the declared source set be shared?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Manifest, privacy inspection and fresh-export validation pass; public remote/release remain separate.

review_checklist: Run local functional and relevant native checks.
Inspect visible copy and real UI renders.
Preserve profile data and signing identity.
Report unmet measurement budgets and publication status.

maturity_model.meaning: Local functional/native gates validate key behavior.
Clean source is prepared; public distribution acceptance remains separate.

residual_risk_wording: This source preview does not establish notarized distribution, end-to-end desktop latency or leak freedom.
